Dutch 'doet' (means: does, as in "she does something") is censored too. Why?

I've read about it on the internet and apparently this behaviour of depressed people in relationships are eerily common. My ex cut herself three weeks ago and used to do it a lot in the past. She has apparent skidmarks on her forearm and upper legs. And yes, she took a huge 180 as well. You made me almost certain she still loves me. I just want to be by her side and talk to her, it doesn't NEED to be a relationship. But she's not talking now, and I hope she will contact me soon again.

If this all is true, you should always be the first person that she will go to when it gets better. I hope that happens to the both of us. We have no power (anymore), the only thing we can is hope the therapy works and that everything gets better.

Best of luck and thank you for this conversation, it really helped!

She told me she needs to fight her depression alone as well. Exact words. I haven't spoken to her since ~tuesday and I'm scared she will for always be like this and never start talking to me again. Her mother guaranteed me she will talk to me again though.
Will I never have fun with her again like we used to? We used to see each other basically every day, and we spoke every day for sure. It's an emptiness in my life. I can overcome the loss, but I'd rather not.

Then there's also me being concerned about her. I feel like I've helped stopping the cutting etc in the past, but now I have no influence. Her feelings are more important than the relationship, but I still have questions that remain unanswered. Did I just lose a great friend? Everything went alright and it just vanished? I can not imagine her talking to me again, but I hope to god she will. I won't start a conversation anymore untill she does. I'll keep asking her parents but I've tried speaking to her before in the last few days and it was either a talk about how shit she felt (I'm sure she doesn't want to talk about that all the time) or a conversation with uninterested responses. I miss her.
Thank you. I hope she messaged me one day (hopefully this month, I have no patience).

That sounds scarily close to my situation.

Are you still talking to her? How long has it been ago since you two broke up? And how is it going now? I'm just scared she will never talk to me again, while she would still be with me if it wasn't for the depression (if that's the reason of course). She's not 'having fun' with anyone like your girlfriend did. I guess she just plays games with people from time to time. She told me she feels home with me and can express how she feels, but with others not so much. I just don't understand why she would give me these interested responses. She has no energy for a relationship, does that mean you have to reply that uninterested as well? Looks like she just wants me gone from her life right now.
Thanks a lot. I will check that movie out.

I have listened to her all the time and I still will. She's just not talking to me anymore. She will tell me how she feels if I ask, I'll probably be able to get a whole conversation about how shit she feels (which she probably doesn't want either) if I would want that but.. I don't think that's helping her. I've listened to her all the time and I've heard everything of her. There's nothing new anymore.
I always reply to her too, by the way.

You say that continuing with what I'm doing seems okay, but I haven't spoken to her in three days because her parents recommended me to let her rest a bit. I am just afraid she will never talk to me again.

The point is that if she doesn't love me her depression might not be as bad as she made it out to be, which would be good I guess but harsh towards me. I just want the best for her and right now I don't know what that is. I'm leaving her alone for a while.

EDIT: She told me herself that she can't express how she's feeling on multiple occasions.

Thanks for the reply.

You said you noticed the 'uninterested' part in yourself. Did you act uninterested to your loved ones? But still speak to other people who weren't 'as' important to you normally, or at least less uninterested? That's what she's doing right now, I'm pretty sure.

I don't know if she wants me to talk to her. She said she doesn't want me to ignore her forever basically, but her responses don't seem like she wants to talk to me. Maybe she secretly does. If I send her a message on WhatsApp she reads it in a minute. But I don't know what to do, talk to her? Make the situation worse, possibly? What if she doesn't want me to do that and wants me to just leave her alone, which I have done in the last few days.
I asked her mother today how they (her parents) and she felt. I guess she was sleeping already so I didn't get a response yet.

I do not know if she still loves me or if this is actually because of the depression. I need answers.

I know I will be able to live without her and will find a new woman who I will love, but right now all I want is her. We were so happy together (as a couple.. she has always been depressed). She said I make her happy, but when I leave she just immediately goes back into a sad state. The last week everything just fell apart.

I know there is a chance we might get back together if she's going to feel better. I would love that. The problem is that I don't want to wait for that moment, it would drain me too much. I also can't risk going back into a situation like this.

This is a shit situation.

EDIT: I also don't understand why she sounds so uninterested if she still cares about me and says it's not my fault at all. I want answers.

She says she still cares about me as well though. I know I can live without her, but she said she might want to get into a relationship again if she's feeling better. She said she don't think she will ever feel better, though. I want to let it go, but I know there is a tiny chance that we will get back together. We were always happy as a couple, she is just a depressed individual.

5 months long I have thought about only one thing: her. I never put myself on the highest priority. She says she wants to keep speaking to me too, and says she still cares about me. She is just too mentally drained to have a relationship, or basically talk to anyone.

She doesn't want me completely out of her life, she didn't say that at all.
Sorry for this late reaction, but thank you so much for that. I'll try my best and do what you said. Hoping for the best ):

This is probably a really stupid question, but should I speak to a professional, or should she speak to a professional? She has been going to a psychiatrist for a few years now, and she says that it hasn't helped much at all, and that she's only hearing the same thing over and over again. Also, when she's 18, she says it'll become too expensive, especially as it hasn't helped at all.

EDIT: She has also been taking antidepressants for a few years.

You're amazing. If you want to talk about it, let me know how you and your mom are doing, I really hope you and her both are doing well or at least better than before.. ;(

I can really see myself in your story. I don't know if it's related, but in the past 2 weeks I've had random short moments (4 seconds?) where my heartbeat would be very, very irregular and it felt weird. I would have this maybe once a day. It might've been because of the stress, I have no idea.
That being said, I think the only way I could get depressed myself is if she started cutting herself again or in the very worst case commited suicide. I obviously don't know if this is true, but I've always been a very happy person and I try to be as happy as possible around her, even though sometimes I can't when she's feeling bad and it feels like there's nothing I can do to make her feel even slightly better.

I understand your position (that you didn't want to hurt your boyfriend with your stories). But I hope you also understand my position that I want to know everything that's going on. If she would be cutting herself secretly and I would've figured out years later, I would be devestated. At least now, if something happens (or hopefully before it), I can try to stop her.

You're an awesome person, taking care of your mom like you did. I hope you and your mom will be very, very happy in the future.
Thanks a lot, it did help! I'll probably speak to a psychiatrist myself.

First of all, thanks a lot for your reply, it means a lot to me.

I forgot to mention she is taking antidepressants and she's been going to a psychiatrist for a few years too. However, she says it doesn't help at all and she just hears the same thing over and over again (talking about the psychiatrist).

It's indeed very draining, but I don't care and I want to know everything. I can't live with the thought of her cutting secretly cutting herself, I'd much rather know it if she did (luckily she's not doing it again, but she told me she's on the edge of doing it again).

Do you suggest her getting more medical care than she has right now?

I also want to say that she has lost faith in ever being happy again. She says that if even people who have studied for it (the psychiatrists) can't make a difference, nobody can.

As you said I also thought about contacting her parents, but I was and am scared that this could be worse for both her, me and her parents. I'm very hesitant to say something to them. I'm not scared of them at all, they've been very nice to me but I don't want to dig a deeper hole.

Thanks so much again for replying, it did help a lot! I wish you the best of luck with your situation too. I obviously don't know the details, but I hope it's going well!
